title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding transforms categorical variables into a form that could be provided to ML algorithms to do a better job in prediction. Each category value is converted into a new categorical column and assigned a $$1$$ or $$0$$ (True/False).

title: Column Rank of One-Hot Encoded Matrix
text: A matrix is full column rank if its columns are linearly independent. For a one-hot encoded matrix, this means that no column can be expressed as a linear combination of the others.
